title: The Ascent

d3d12.selection: DirectX 12 is the game's default since the hotfix of 2021-09-01; the in-game DirectX choice (Main Menu, needs a restart) overrides it

d3d11.selection: Unreal Engine 4 command line -dx11 (engine documentation; community reports it works for this game), or the in-game DirectX choice

steam.launch_entry: 0: TheAscent.exe -Installed (the Unreal bootstrap at the install root; appinfo cache of 2026-09-30)

app_profile.proposal: none for the first D3D12 session (the game starts with ray tracing off). For a ray tracing session: TheAscent-Win64-Shipping.exe Experiment=raytracing-tier, the one switch that makes the shell report the engine's raytracing tier (adapter-caps.cpp; without it RaytracingTier is NOT_SUPPORTED and the game cannot offer ray tracing).

notes: The shipping image path is the Unreal Engine 4 packaging layout (community); the bootstrap TheAscent.exe at the root comes from the Steam entry. The lab check (DRY_RUN=lab) confirms both before a session.
Hotfix 2021-09-01: DirectX 12 default; ray tracing off by default and turned on in the Main Menu graphics options; a first start caches shaders for 20-25 s at the main menu.
Settings are only recorded (hash before and after), never written: policy record.
